points.description: First blank: dams (or reservoirs/storage structures such as dams and reservoirs, clear synonyms accepted).
Second blank: reservoirs or canals (either accepted; canals as water conveyance/transfer channels).

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each of the two blanks correctly filled: one for dams and one for reservoirs or canals. Either order is fine, and clear synonyms (e.g. storage tanks, water transfer channels) are accepted. Wrong or unrelated items such as wells or pumps get no mark. Repeating the same item twice earns only 1 mark.
